sn55.52:1.1: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn55.52:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho Kapilavatthum anuppatto hoti kenacid eva karaṇīyena || || 3.
sn55.52:1.3: Assosum kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā || aññataro bhikkhu Sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vutto Kapilavatthum anuppatto ti || || 4.
sn55.52:2.1: Atha kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antam nisinnā kho Kāpilavatthavā sakyā tam bhikkhum etad avocuṃ || || 5.
sn55.52:2.2: Kacci bhante Bhagavā arogo ceva balavā cā ti || ||
sn55.52:2.3: Arogo cāvuso Bhagavā balavā cā ti || ||
sn55.52:3.1: Kacci pana bhante Sāriputta-Moggalānā arogā ceva balavanto cā ti || || Sāriputta-Moggalānā
sn55.52:3.2: pi kho avuso arogā ceva balavanto cā ti || ||
sn55.52:4.1: Kacci pana bhante bhikkhusaṅgho arogo ca balavā cā ti || ||
sn55.52:4.2: Bhikkhusaṅgho pi kho āvuso arogo ca balavā cā ti || || 6.
sn55.52:5.1: Atthi pana te bhante kiñci iminā antaravassena Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītan ti || ||
sn55.52:5.2: Sammukhā me tam āvuso Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ || ||
sn55.52:5.3: Appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti ||
sn55.52:5.4: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā asmā lokā ti || || 7.
sn55.52:6.1: Aparampi kho me āvuso Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ || ||
sn55.52:6.2: Appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye pañcannam orambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā asmā lokā ||
sn55.52:6.3: atha kho ete bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokam āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantī ti || || 8.
sn55.52:7.1: Aparam pi kho me āvuso Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā patiggahītaṃ || ||
sn55.52:7.2: Appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ samyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakid eva imaṃ lokam āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti ||
sn55.52:7.3: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā
